description.text: Babolat Air Crest 2026: light, forgiving and easy to handle

Babolat built the Air Crest 2026 for beginner and intermediate players who are starting to improve and still want a comfortable racket. The head is an oversized teardrop , the balance is medium and it weighs 345 g . It's a light racket, and you notice it most at the net and in quick exchanges.

Its fibreglass faces and soft EVA core give a soft touch and easy ball output from the first match. The Oversize Sweetspot makes the racket more tolerant of off-centre hits, so shots stay precise even when your timing isn't perfect. It comes in black and grey with a matt finish.
What does the oversized teardrop shape bring to your game?

Power and control in similar amounts , for both defence and attack. The medium balance spreads the weight evenly along the racket, so it feels stable in your hand. Because the head is oversized, the sweet spot is bigger too, and balls you don't hit cleanly still go over with some precision.
How hard is the Air Crest 2026?

It's a soft racket . The fibreglass faces give a more flexible touch, and the soft EVA core cushions each hit and reduces vibration. The hybrid carbon and fibreglass frame adds the rigidity and durability that a soft racket needs, making it a good fit for players who value comfort over a stiff, demanding feel.
Key features and technology in the Babolat Air Crest 2026

items: Oversize Sweetspot — a larger sweet spot for more tolerance and more precise shots
Hybrid Frame — carbon and fibreglass for rigidity, flexibility and durability
Improver Heart — better weight distribution and a correct racket position
Fibreglass faces — comfortable ball output and a more flexible touch
Soft EVA core — soft cushioning that reduces vibration
Flat surface with a matt finish
Teardrop shape with a medium balance
345 g weight for quick, precise movements

description.text: Will the Air Crest 2026 help me improve my technique?

Yes — the Improver Heart helps keep the racket in the correct position, and the Oversize Sweetspot forgives mistakes while you work on your strokes. Combined with its low weight, that makes it easier to focus on technique rather than fighting the racket.
Is it light enough for fast play at the net?
Yes — at 345 g it's noticeably light, so you can react quickly on volleys and in fast exchanges. That lightness also means less fatigue over a long session.
Is the Babolat Air Crest 2026 worth it?
Yes — if you're a beginner or intermediate player looking for a light, comfortable racket that forgives mistakes while you work on your game.
